  <p class="post-meta">Gemini Summary: 9:30PM</p>


<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Broad-based market rally:</strong> The Sensex jumped 889 points to close at 24,250, driven by strong performance in the IT and banking sectors alongside renewed FII inflows.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I14</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Corporate earnings and currency:</strong> Dabur India reported a 15% YoY rise in net profit to ₹591 crore, while the rupee strengthened for the fourth consecutive session, reaching a three-week high supported by RBI intervention.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I11</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I12</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Fiscal concerns:</strong> The Finance Ministry cautioned that the recent surge in crude oil prices, exacerbated by geopolitical tensions in West Asia, poses a significant risk to India&#x27;s fiscal deficit and current account stability.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I16</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I17</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Fed policy anticipation:</strong> Domestic markets defied global uncertainty to rally ahead of the upcoming US Federal Reserve policy decision, which remains the primary focus for global investors.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W14</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Commodity market movements:</strong> Gold prices remained steady at ₹1.47 lakh per 10 grams in Delhi, while silver saw gains as investors balanced geopolitical risks with the impending US monetary policy outcome.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W21</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W22</a></span></li>
</ul>
